org.name: Kubera Research
org.tagline: Public filings and open market data, indexed end to end. Not investment advice.

sections.name: World
sections.description: Governments, currencies, bilateral trade and the energy complex behind them.

dashboards.title: Governments
dashboards.blurb: Inflation, growth, unemployment and currency for 212 countries, on a rotatable globe.
dashboards.source: World Bank, WITS and Yahoo — rendered natively by the hub

dashboards.title: Trade
dashboards.blurb: Seaborne trade on a rotatable globe: 2,065 ports, the 28 maritime chokepoints, and the flows between them drawn as ribbons — thickness for value, colour for cargo. Click any port, ribbon, chokepoint or country for its history since 2019.
dashboards.source: IMF PortWatch — AIS-derived port calls and tonnage for 2,065 ports and 28 chokepoints, plus port-to-country flows valued by industry. Built into the warehouse by dbt and republished weekly on Tuesdays; bilateral customs values from World Bank WITS.

dashboards.title: Sectors
dashboards.blurb: The ten global sector funds ranked, plus the same window read by region.
dashboards.source: World Bank, WITS and Yahoo — rendered natively by the hub

dashboards.title: Energy
dashboards.blurb: Crude, both gas benchmarks, refined products, the metals that price them and the broad basket.
dashboards.source: World Bank, WITS and Yahoo — rendered natively by the hub

dashboards.title: Weather
dashboards.blurb: Live conditions at 212 capitals on the globe — temperature, feels-like, humidity, precipitation and wind — with the world's significant wildfires, active tropical cyclones, and every capital currently reporting a thunderstorm.
dashboards.source: Open-Meteo worldwide, GDACS for wildfires, NOAA National Hurricane Center for Atlantic and Pacific cyclones — rendered natively by the hub

sections.name: Markets
sections.description: Price action, realised risk, and the macroeconomic and trade backdrop behind it.

dashboards.title: Stock Explorer
dashboards.blurb: Search any listed company and chart it over 1/5/10 years or all time — or sweep the market by sector and send a whole industry to the chart.
dashboards.source: Yahoo Finance, live — rendered natively by the hub

sections.name: Companies
sections.description: Company financials as filed and as converted, normalised for currency and comparable across markets.

dashboards.title: Company Explorer
dashboards.blurb: Open any company for its price history, valuation, income statement, balance sheet and cash flow — with the filed figures beside them for the names are indexed in the warehouse.
dashboards.source: Yahoo Finance, live — rendered natively by the hub, plus fact_financials for held names

sections.name: Portfolio
sections.description: Build a portfolio from anything indexed, then measure what it actually did.

dashboards.title: Portfolio Analytics
dashboards.blurb: Assemble a portfolio, weight it, and read its return, risk, concentration and attribution against a benchmark or against gold.
dashboards.source: Yahoo live, priced in any currency
